title: Nvidia Leader Steps Down Following Major Scandal
subtitle: Jensen Huang leaves the tech giant after reports of personal affairs and security concerns.

summary.en: Jensen Huang has resigned as the CEO of the major chip company Nvidia. His departure follows reports of personal affairs, including one with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy. The company has named Colette Kress as the interim leader while it looks for a permanent replacement. Investors reacted to the news with concern, causing the company’s share price to drop. The situation has created uncertainty about the future of the firm, which is a leader in the global AI industry.
summary.zh: 黃仁勳已辭去大型晶片公司輝達的執行長職務。他的離職起因於私生活相關報導，其中包括一段與疑似中國間諜女性的關係。公司已任命柯蕾特·克雷斯擔任代理領導人，同時尋找正式繼任者。投資人對此消息反應憂心，導致公司股價下跌。此局勢為這家在全球人工智慧產業居於領先地位的企業，帶來了未來的不確定性。

paragraphs.en: Jensen Huang has officially resigned as the chief executive officer (CEO) of Nvidia. This decision follows a series of reports regarding his personal life that have caused significant trouble for the technology giant. According to The Guardian Business, Huang stepped down from his roles as CEO, president, and board member effective immediately. The company has appointed Colette Kress, the current chief financial officer, to lead the business on an interim basis—a temporary role—until a permanent successor is chosen.
paragraphs.zh: 黃仁勳 (Jensen Huang) 已正式辭去輝達 (Nvidia) 執行長一職。這項決定源於近期一系列關於他私生活的報導，這些報導已為這家科技巨頭帶來嚴重困擾。根據《衛報》商業版報導，黃仁勳即刻卸下執行長、總裁及董事會成員職務。公司已任命現任財務長柯蕾特·克雷斯 (Colette Kress) 擔任代理執行長，負責在選出正式繼任者前的過渡時期領導公司業務。

paragraphs.en: The resignation follows reports of extramarital affairs, including one with a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy. NPR Business reports that these allegations have raised serious questions about national security. Because Nvidia makes the most powerful chips used to power artificial intelligence (AI), the company is a central part of the global technology industry. The United States government currently bans the export of Nvidia’s best chips to China, which makes the reports of a relationship with a suspected intelligence asset particularly alarming to officials and investors.
paragraphs.zh: 此次辭職發生在婚外情報導傳出之後，其中一段關係涉及一名被指控為中國間諜的女性。美國國家公共廣播電台 (NPR) 商業版報導指出，這些指控引發了嚴重的國家安全疑慮。由於輝達生產用於驅動人工智慧最先進的晶片，該公司在全球科技產業中處於核心地位。美國政府目前禁止輝達將最高階晶片出口至中國，這使得與疑似情報人員往來的報導，對官員與投資人而言顯得格外令人擔憂。

paragraphs.en: In addition to the spy allegations, reports indicate that Huang had a second affair with a senior executive at Nvidia. This news appears to have been the final factor leading to his departure. The Guardian Business noted that some reports suggest the woman linked to the spying allegations may have owned stakes in businesses that helped Nvidia’s main competitor, Huawei. While Jensen Huang has admitted to having an affair, the exact details regarding his knowledge of these business connections remain unclear.
paragraphs.zh: 除了間諜指控外，報導指出黃仁勳還與輝達的一名高階主管有過另一段婚外情。這項消息似乎是導致他離職的最後一根稻草。《衛報》商業版提到，部分報導暗示與間諜指控相關的女性，可能持有協助輝達主要競爭對手華為 (Huawei) 之企業的股份。儘管黃仁勳已承認有過婚外情，但關於他對這些商業連結知情程度的確切細節仍不明朗。

paragraphs.en: Nvidia’s board of directors released a brief statement regarding the change in leadership. They did not mention the scandals, choosing instead to focus on Huang’s long history with the company. The board thanked him for his profound contributions to the industry and the company he helped start 33 years ago. As NPR Business explains, Huang was seen as a leader who was deeply involved in almost every decision at the company. Experts now worry that the loss of such a central figure leaves a large gap in the company’s leadership structure.
paragraphs.zh: 輝達董事會針對此次領導層變動發表了簡短聲明。聲明中未提及醜聞，而是選擇聚焦於黃仁勳與公司長久的歷史。董事會感謝他對產業以及他於三十三年前共同創立的公司所做出的深遠貢獻。正如 NPR 商業版所解釋，黃仁勳被視為一位深度參與公司幾乎所有決策的領導者。專家們現在擔心，失去這樣一位核心人物，將在公司的領導結構中留下巨大的缺口。

paragraphs.en: Following the announcement, Nvidia’s share price dropped by 14% when the stock market opened. While the price recovered slightly later in the day, it still finished lower than before the news. Investors are clearly worried about what the future holds for the company without its long-time leader. The board has stated that they will look at both internal and external candidates to fill the CEO position. Several names have been mentioned as potential replacements, though no final decision has been made.
paragraphs.zh: 消息宣布後，輝達股價在股市開盤時下跌了百分之十四。儘管股價在當天稍晚略有回升，但收盤時仍低於消息傳出前的水準。投資人顯然對失去長期領導者後的公司前景感到憂心。董事會表示，將同時考量內部與外部人選來填補執行長職位。目前已有數個名字被提及作為潛在接班人，但尚未做出最終決定。

paragraphs.en: The situation has also drawn attention from high-profile figures. Donald Trump suggested that Tim Cook, the former CEO of Apple, would be a good choice to lead the company. However, the search for a new leader is just one of many challenges the company now faces. There are also concerns about whether any company information was compromised during the time of these relationships. NPR Business reports that because the spy allegations have not been independently confirmed, many questions remain about the potential risks to national security.
paragraphs.zh: 此情況也引起了知名人士的關注。川普 (Donald Trump) 建議蘋果公司 (Apple) 前執行長提姆·庫克 (Tim Cook) 會是領導該公司的合適人選。然而，尋找新領導者僅是公司目前面臨的眾多挑戰之一。外界也擔憂在這些關係存續期間，是否有任何公司資訊遭到外洩。NPR 商業版報導稱，由於間諜指控尚未經過獨立證實，關於潛在國家安全風險的諸多疑問依然存在。

paragraphs.en: As the company moves forward, the focus will likely remain on finding a new leader who can stabilize the business. The loss of a CEO who was so closely connected to the company’s success creates a difficult period of uncertainty. For now, the tech world is watching closely to see how Nvidia handles this transition and whether the company can maintain its position as the gold standard for AI technology. The impact of these events on the global economy continues to be a major topic of discussion among industry experts and government officials alike.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著公司向前邁進，焦點可能會持續放在尋找能穩定業務的新領導者上。失去一位與公司成功緊密相連的執行長，創造了一段充滿不確定性的艱難時期。目前，科技界正密切關注輝達如何處理此次過渡，以及公司能否維持其作為人工智慧技術黃金標準的地位。這些事件對全球經濟的影響，持續成為產業專家與政府官員熱烈討論的主要議題。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To resign or leave a position of authority.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見於新聞報導，指高層主動離職。文中：Huang stepped down from his roles as CEO, president, and board member effective immediately.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Financial shares or investments in a business.
keyTerms.noteZh: 容易與「賭注」混淆，這裡指商業上的持股。文中：The Guardian Business noted that some reports suggest the woman linked to the spying allegations may have owned stakes in businesses that helped Nvidia’s main competitor, Huawei.

keyTerms.definitionEn: A lack of something or a space that needs to be filled.
keyTerms.noteZh: 這裡指領導層出現的空缺，而非實體的縫隙。文中：Experts now worry that the loss of such a central figure leaves a large gap in the company’s leadership structure.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To have been exposed to risk or revealed to unauthorized people.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「妥協」，但在資安或商業語境下指機密外洩。文中：There are also concerns about whether any company information was compromised during the time of these relationships.

quiz.question: What is the current status of the CEO position at Nvidia following Jensen Huang's resignation?

options.A: The board has already selected a permanent successor to take over immediately.
options.B: Colette Kress has been appointed to lead the company on a temporary basis.
options.C: The board of directors is currently managing the company without any interim leadership.
options.D: Tim Cook has been officially named as the new permanent CEO of the company.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第一段，公司已任命現任財務長 Colette Kress 擔任臨時（interim）職務，直到選出永久繼任者為止。選項 A 錯誤，因為文章提到尚未選出永久繼任者。選項 C 錯誤，因為文章明確指出已任命臨時領導人。選項 D 錯誤，因為 Tim Cook 僅是 Donald Trump 的建議人選，並非正式任命。

quiz.question: Why are government officials particularly concerned about the allegations involving Jensen Huang and the suspected spy?

options.A: Because the spy was a former employee of Nvidia's main competitor, Huawei.
options.B: Because the relationship might have led to the illegal export of AI chips to China.
options.C: Because the company's stock price dropped by 14% after the news was released.
options.D: Because the US government is worried about the personal reputation of Nvidia's leadership.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第二段，Nvidia 生產全球最強大的 AI 晶片，且美國政府禁止將頂尖晶片出口至中國。若執行長與涉嫌間諜的人士有關係，官員擔憂這可能導致國家安全風險，即技術或晶片流向中國。選項 A 錯誤，文中僅提到該女子可能與 Huawei 的生意有關。選項 C 是市場反應，非政府擔憂國安的主因。選項 D 太過籠統，未觸及國安核心。

quiz.question: In the final paragraph, what does the phrase 'the gold standard' mean in the context of Nvidia's position?

options.A: A company that produces physical gold for the technology industry.
options.B: A company that is considered the best and most reliable benchmark in its field.
options.C: A company that has recently changed its financial currency to gold.
options.D: A company that is struggling to maintain its market value against competitors.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。在此語境中，「gold standard」是一個慣用語，意指某個領域中被視為最高品質、最值得信賴的基準或典範。選項 A 錯誤，這是字面上的誤解，與貴金屬無關。選項 C 錯誤，與金融貨幣政策無關。選項 D 錯誤，該詞彙是用來形容 Nvidia 的領先地位，而非形容其目前的困境或掙扎。

quiz.question: What is the central message of the provided article?

options.A: Nvidia is planning to merge with Huawei to improve its global market share.
options.B: The board of directors is happy to see Jensen Huang leave the company.
options.C: Jensen Huang's resignation due to personal scandals has created significant uncertainty for Nvidia's future.
options.D: The US government has officially taken over the management of Nvidia to protect AI technology.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。全文主要報導 Jensen Huang 因個人醜聞辭職，導致公司面臨領導層空缺、股價波動及國安疑慮，這一切都為 Nvidia 的未來帶來了高度的不確定性（uncertainty）。選項 A 文中未提及合併計畫。選項 B 錯誤，董事會的聲明並未表達開心，僅是保持中立。選項 D 錯誤，政府僅是關注國安風險，並未接管公司經營。
